thread:
maria: Publish pipeline choking on samplekit SDK publish — typegen step failed after a semver bump, CI blocked.
jonathan: ugh. can you paste the typegen logs?
maria: ```error: TypeGenMismatchError: generated types differ from repo\n--- a/generated.ts\n+++ b/generated.ts\n@@ -1,3 +1,4 @@\n+// trailing newline
```
CI job: https://ci.internal/xyz/123 :face_with_raised_eyebrow:
raj: we rolled an auth/retry ordering change in runtime last week — could that affect any metadata used by typegen?
lisa: i ran `yarn regen` locally. diff is tiny: changelog header formatting (an extra space after `- `) shows up in the generated file comment, which flips the hash. so typegen flags a mismatch.
maria: huh, changelog whitespace affecting generated types sounds like a leak. should be impossible.
jonathan: looks like typegen embeds package metadata comments (including a changelog snippet) into the generated header. whitespace changes change the output -> failing CI.
devx-bot: CI #4567 failed: typegen step (stage: publish). See https://ci.internal/xyz/123
raj: quick proposal: normalize comment whitespace before computing the generation hash. simple sanitizer in the generator pipeline.
lisa: temporary workaround: pin typegen action in publish workflow to `redwood/typegen@v1.3.2` so releases can proceed while we patch.
maria: i'll open a PR to normalize comments + add a regen check in prepublish. also add a regression test: changelog whitespace should be ignored.
jonathan: and add a changelog linter rule in CI to catch this formatting drift earlier.
maria: ok — i'll create branch `fix/typegen-comment-normalize` and assign @raj and @lisa. will also revert the pin in a follow-up.
raj: on it. i'll push the sanitizer and a unit test that asserts identical typegen output for trimmed vs untrimmed changelog samples.
lisa: local reminder: run `yarn regen --check` before cutting a release; i'll add it to the samplekit README.
maria: thanks everyone — i'll update here once CI is green or PR is up. tagging @eng-devex for visibility :thumbsup:
